newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains dealers post HRW wheat protection.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains dealers post HRW wheat protection.

text.p: U.S. Plains grain dealers in Kansas and Oklahoma reported taking scattered two-cent-a-bushel protection on hard red winter wheat bids amid expectations of lower KCBT HRW wheat futures contracts.
One Oklahoma dealer also posted two cents protection on both corn and sorghum.
In Kansas, a dealer said there was two cents protection on corn, four cents on sorghum and two cents on soybeans.
Weakness from Project A overnight trade on CBOT wheat futures was another factor in the protection, the dealer said.
CBOT wheat was seen opening two to three cents lower.
